<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class C {
    istream* in;
    ostream* out;
    stringTokenizer st;
    bool eof;

public:
    C() {
        in = &cin;
        out = &cout;
        submit();
        // stress();
    }

    void submit() {
        nextInt();
        string s = nextToken();
        *out << fast(s) << "\n";
        // *out << slow(s) << "\n";
    }

    static const string BAD;
    static const string STR;
    static const int INF = 1000000;

    string prepare(const string& s) {
        string sb;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
                sb.push_back(c);
            } else {
                sb.push_back('A');
            }
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int slow(string s) {
        s = prepare(s);
        unordered_map<string, int> map;
        queue<string> que;
        que.push(s);
        map[s] = 0;

        while (true) {
            s = que.front(); que.pop();
            int curD = map[s];
            if (s.find(BAD) == string::npos) {
                return curD;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < s.length(); i++) {
                string nxt = swap(s, i, i + 1);
                if (!nxt.empty() && map.find(nxt) == map.end()) {
                    map[nxt] = curD + 1;
                    que.push(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
        return -1; // should not reach here
    }

    string swap(const string& s, size_t i, size_t j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
        string buf = s;
        std::swap(buf[i], buf[j]);
        return buf;
    }

    int fast(const string& s_input) {
        string s = prepare(s_input);
        size_t n = s.length();

        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<vector<int>> pos(3);
        vector<int> sz(3, 0);

        vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            cntHere[i].resize(n, vector<int>(3,0));
        }

        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3,0));

        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = STR.find(s[i]);
            int c = a[i];
            cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i];
            pos[c].push_back(i);
            sz[c]++;
            for (int c2 = 0; c2 < 3; c2++) {
                pref[i + 1][c2] = pref[i][c2];
            }
            pref[i + 1][c] += 1;
        }

        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(sz[0]+1, vector<vector<int>>(sz[1]+1, vector<int>(sz[2]+1, INF))));
        int ans = INF;

        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

        for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 <= sz[0]; j0++) {
            for (size_t j1 = 0; j1 <= sz[1]; j1++) {
                for (size_t j2 = 0; j2 <= sz[2]; j2++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (curVal == INF) continue;
                        if (idx == n) {
                            ans = std::min(ans, curVal);
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (j0 < sz[0]) {
                            int cost = std::max((int)j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0) + std::max((int)j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                            dp[1][j0+1][j1][j2] = std::min(dp[1][j0+1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j1 < sz[1] && last == 0) {
                            int cost = std::max((int)j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0) + std::max((int)j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1+1][j2] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1+1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j2 < sz[2]) {
                            int cost = std::max((int)j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0) + std::max((int)j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2+1] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2+1], curVal + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static const string BAD;
    static const string STR;

    string nextToken() {
        while (st.tokens.empty()) {
            if (!getline(*in, buffer)) {
                eof = true;
                return "";
            }
            st.tokens = split(buffer);
        }
        string res = st.tokens.front(); st.tokens.erase(st.tokens.begin());
        return res;
    }

    string nextString() {
        string res;
        getline(*in, res);
        if (in->fail()) {
            eof = true;
        }
        return res;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stoi(token);
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stoll(token);
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stod(token);
    }

private:
    struct stringTokenizer {
        vector<string> tokens;
    };

    string buffer;
};

const string C::BAD = "VK";
const string C::STR = "VKA";

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    C c;
    return 0;
}
